title: KHR_texture_procedural_rendering Procedure
description: A procedure: a small program that draws an approximation of a texture's picture at any resolution. It is referenced as an image is: by a URI or by a buffer view.

uri.description: The URI (or IRI) of the procedure.
uri.gltf_detailedDescription: The URI (or IRI) of the procedure. Relative paths are relative to the current glTF asset. Instead of referencing an external file, this field MAY contain a `data:`-URI. This field MUST NOT be defined when `bufferView` is defined.

bufferView.description: The index of the bufferView that contains the procedure. This field MUST NOT be defined when `uri` is defined.

mimeType.description: The procedure's media type. This field MUST be defined when `bufferView` is defined.

language.description: The language the procedure is written in.

anyOf.description: One operator per line, its parameters as 32-bit words in hexadecimal.

version.description: The version of the procedure's language.

byteLength.description: The length of the procedure in bytes.
